column1: # Pinned digests for the Bats source archives this action downloads.
# Format: <version><TAB><sha256 of the DECOMPRESSED tar stream>
# The hash covers the tar, not the .tar.gz as served. GitHub generates these archives on demand
# and does not guarantee the compressed bytes are stable -- in January 2023 a change to its gzip
# settings altered the checksum of every source archive on the platform without any repository
# content changing. That incident changed the gzip framing only; the tar payload is derived from
# git objects and is fixed by the tag. Hashing after decompression therefore survives a recompression
# while still detecting a tampered download or a moved tag.
